name: Music Makers Tribute to the Heavy Hitters
description: Music Makers Tribute to... The Heavy Hitters bring some of the biggest artists, most influential songs, and most enduring sounds in music history to one of New York City's most iconic live music stages: the Iridium in the heart of Times Square. Featuring two distinct tribute experiences, The Heavy Hitters will move across genres and generations, celebrating artists whose music has become part of the soundtrack of our lives. Whether you're drawn to the powerhouse vocals and deep grooves of classic soul or the unmistakable piano-driven hits of Billy Joel and Elton John, you'll have the opportunity to enjoy music that has inspired generations of musicians and audiences. SOUL ROYALTY: The Voices That Defined Soul﻿ Soul Royalty celebrates the legendary singers, unforgettable grooves, and timeless songs that defined the genre---from Aretha Franklin, Otis Redding, Sam Cooke, and Marvin Gaye to Al Green, Stevie Wonder, and beyond. KINGS OF KEYS: The Piano Legends Who Changed Music ﻿Billy Joel. Elton John. Two legendary piano players. Decades of unforgettable songs. ﻿Step into the world of piano-driven classic rock and delight in the iconic parts, soaring melodies, and timeless songs that made these artists household names. I'm Every Woman starring Mona Swain presented by 24k Theatre Co. 24k Theatre Co. presents I'm Every Woman, starring Mona Swain! From portraying Tina Turner in the national tour of TINA: The Tina Turner Musical to bringing Whitney Houston's iconic hits to life in The Bodyguard and stepping into the world of Donna Summer, Mona has embodied three of music's most legendary women. For one night only, experience Mona bringing all three of her iconic roles together on one stage at The Iridium! Presented by 24k Theatre Co., an acclaimed, female-led, internationally based production company whose credits include Just a Piano, Night of the Living Legends, and productions at 54 Below, The Triad, and the Toronto Fringe Festival. Dedicated to honoring the past while shaping the future, 24k brings its signature celebration of extraordinary talent and timeless music to this unforgettable evening! Mad Staggers Get ready for a detonation of unapologetic, dirty rock and roll as NYC's premier powerpop-infused outfit, the Mad Staggers, bring their ferocious, high-voltage energy to the legendary stage at The Iridium. Known for tearing up the local club scene with an old-school rock mentality, this formidable four-piece combines the gritty charisma of The Faces with heavy powerpop hooks. Fronted by the magnetic Chris Campion, the lineup features Benny Landa on guitar, Gary Bristol on bass, and Keith Foley driving the beat on drums. About Music Makers Bob Elliott's Music Makers is NYC's premier band ensemble program, where business professionals and passionate music enthusiasts come together to rehearse, refine their craft, and perform live. BEMM has performed over 700 shows at iconic venues like South Street Seaport, Alice Tully Hall, The Cutting Room, The Bitter End, and many more, delivering unforgettable live music experiences. In addition to musicianship development, we also provide a top-tier rehearsal space, offering world-class service to musicians from around the globe.

name: A Ghost in Your Ear
description: When an actor arrives late to a sound studio for a last-minute audiobook recording session, he is handed the script of a chilling ghost story to read. But as the engineer cues the recording and the evening wears on, the horrors slowly begin to escape the page to haunt the studio itself. Fresh from an acclaimed, sold-out run in London, A GHOST IN YOUR EAR is the "truly terrifying headphone horror" (The Guardian) from the darkly brilliant mind of Tony Award® nominee Jamie Armitage (SIX), made in collaboration with Ben and Max Ringham (ANNA, National Theatre). A mesmerizing blend of gothic horror and psychological thriller, this cutting-edge theatrical experience uses groundbreaking binaural sound technology to immerse every audience member in a haunting world of sound. And at Audible's Minetta Lane Theatre - one of New York's most intimate venues - there's no escaping the frights. Enter if you dare.
why: Ghost-story play set in a sound studio, staged at Minetta Lane.

name: The Conversation
description: THE CONVERSATION follows Marcus (Tony Award-winner Joshua Henry) and Elle (Julia Harriman) from the electric spark of their first date to move-ins, milestones, and the slow accumulation of everything left unsaid. With a book by Nick Green and directed by Tony Award-winner Kenny Leon, The Conversation asks what it takes to choose love, even when it hurts, and what it takes to stay.
